info.title: Cocktail Cabinet API
info.description: Private self-hosted cocktail collection. Bearer tokens grant read or read/write access, never more than the owning account's role. Members manage personal shelves, own recipes and own account/tokens. Administrators additionally manage shared ingredients/categories, members and invitations. Destructive catalog operations reject references unless explicitly merged; merges and batches are transactional. Passwords and newly issued credentials are REST-only and never exposed through MCP tool output.
